# Pinned metal cooking advancement fixtures

These six JSON files are copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes/misc/common/materials

existing Cobalt ingot recipe IDs are documented in
`docs/metal-cooking-unlocks.md`.
